original_video_rule: An effect triggered when the unit is placed on the battlefield.
An effect that lasts as long as the unit is on the battlefield. Expires when Suppressed.
Units adjacent to each other in the same horizontal row. Line up a certain number of units with the "Line" affix to trigger certain effects.
Units adjacent to each other in the same vertical column. Place units with the "Column" affix behind or in front of one another to trigger certain effects.
An effect triggered when the unit is placed in the back field.
An effect triggered when the unit is placed in the front row.
At the end of your turn, gains 1 Power.
Sustained effects and special effects (inspired, scorched) expire and Power bonuses are removed.
